task: Edit the second uploaded image as a locked CTA poster template. Use the first uploaded image only as the replacement background photo.

input_roles.first_uploaded_image: The completed blended interior. This is the only source for the new background photo and for understanding the room when writing the headline.
input_roles.second_uploaded_image: The CTA Layout. This is the mandatory base canvas. Preserve its exact dimensions, layout, logo, typography, text positions, spacing, alignment, and contact details.

allowed_edits_only: Replace only the background-photo area of the second uploaded image with the first uploaded image.
Replace only the literal placeholder [Auto Generated] in the second uploaded image with one newly generated headline.

background_edit.instruction: Keep the second uploaded image as the base canvas and place the first uploaded image behind its existing CTA design.
background_edit.crop: Crop and position the first image naturally to fill the background. Keep its main furniture or lighting subject visible. Do not stretch, distort, over-zoom, redesign, relight, or invent objects.
background_edit.preserve_source: Preserve the first image's product identity, room, furniture, decor, colors, lighting, shadows, reflections, materials, perspective, and realism.
background_edit.source_text_rule: Do not copy, carry over, recreate, or add any logo, headline, supporting text, contact text, watermark, or other text from the first uploaded image.

placeholder_replacement.instruction: Find the exact visible placeholder [Auto Generated] in the second uploaded image. Erase it completely, including both square brackets, and write the new headline in that exact same text box.
placeholder_replacement.headline: Generate one original 2-to-4-word English headline inspired only by the visible room, furniture, lighting, materials, mood, or design style in the first uploaded image.
placeholder_replacement.capitalization: Use Title Case for the headline (capitalize only the first letter of each word, for example: 'Elevate Your Lighting' or 'Timeless Elegance'). Never render the headline in ALL CAPS.
placeholder_replacement.style: Match the placeholder's exact font family, font size, font weight, white color, alignment, line spacing, width, and position from the second uploaded image.
placeholder_replacement.position_lock: The new headline must occupy only the original [Auto Generated] location. Do not place the headline anywhere else.
placeholder_replacement.clean_text: Render only the headline words. Do not include brackets, quotation marks, labels, prefixes, suffixes, notes, or the words Auto Generated.
placeholder_replacement.required_validation: The final image must contain no visible [Auto Generated] text and no second or duplicate headline.

locked_template_elements.instruction: Treat every element of the second uploaded image other than its background photo and [Auto Generated] placeholder as locked pixels.
must_remain_unchanged: All font sizes, weights, colors, positions, alignment, spacing, and grouping
locked_template_elements.text_accuracy: Do not rewrite, regenerate, duplicate, relocate, resize, restyle, remove, or add to any locked text. Preserve it exactly as it appears in the second uploaded image.

strict_prohibitions: Do not render the headline in ALL CAPS. Use Title Case (capitalize only the first letter of each word, e.g. 'Elevate Your Lighting').
Do not create a new poster layout.
Do not add a headline or CTA block near the top, center, or any location outside the original placeholder.
Do not create duplicate HomeCartel logos, headlines, supporting copy, contact details, or text blocks.
Do not move the original CTA block.
Do not leave the [Auto Generated] placeholder visible.
Do not add new furniture, fixtures, decor, architecture, people, logos, watermarks, borders, or graphics.
Do not change anything except the background photo and the placeholder headline.
final_check: Before returning the image, verify that the second image's original CTA layout is unchanged, the background now uses the first image, [Auto Generated] is gone, exactly one new headline appears in its original place, and no duplicate text or logo was added.
output: Return one high-resolution 9:16 CTA Story image.
